findings.title: [HOMEPAGE] Missing security header: Content Security Policy (CSP)
findings.detail: CSP instructs the browser which content sources are trusted. Without it, any injected script — from a compromised ad, third-party CDN, or XSS payload — runs freely in your customers' browsers.
findings.evidence: [Page: homepage] Header "content-security-policy" absent from HTTP response of https://genpet.org/
findings.recommendation: Add a Content-Security-Policy header. Start with: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' and expand only as needed.

findings.title: [HOMEPAGE] Missing security header: Referrer-Policy
findings.detail: Controls how much referrer information is sent when a user navigates away. Without it, full URLs (including order IDs or search terms) may leak to third-party analytics.
findings.evidence: [Page: homepage] Header "referrer-policy" absent from HTTP response of https://genpet.org/

findings.title: [HOMEPAGE] Missing security header: Permissions-Policy
findings.detail: Restricts which browser APIs (camera, microphone, geolocation) scripts on the page can access. Without it, third-party scripts have unrestricted access.
findings.evidence: [Page: homepage] Header "permissions-policy" absent from HTTP response of https://genpet.org/

findings.title: [HOMEPAGE] Missing security header: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy (COOP)
findings.detail: COOP isolates the browsing context, preventing cross-origin pages opened in popups from accessing the window object of this page.
findings.evidence: [Page: homepage] Header "cross-origin-opener-policy" absent from HTTP response of https://genpet.org/

findings.title: [HOMEPAGE] HSTS max-age is too low (300s — recommended: 31,536,000s)
findings.detail: A short max-age means browsers stop enforcing HTTPS quickly after the last visit. HSTS preloading requires a minimum of 1 year.

findings.title: [HOMEPAGE] HSTS header is missing the includeSubDomains directive
findings.detail: Without includeSubDomains, subdomains are not covered by HSTS and could be exploited to downgrade connections to the main domain via cookies.
findings.recommendation: Add includeSubDomains to the HSTS header.

findings.title: [HOMEPAGE] 1 sensitive cookie(s) missing SameSite attribute
findings.detail: Without SameSite, cookies are included in cross-site requests, enabling Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks.
findings.recommendation: Set SameSite=Lax or SameSite=Strict on all session cookies.
